site.description: Point of sale, stock control and accounts for Sri Lankan restaurants and cafés. VAT and SSCL bills, food costing, and your daily numbers on your phone.

pricing.note: Launch prices. Setup includes menu loading, bill and tax configuration, and staff training. Cloud, payment and messaging charges are billed to you directly by those providers.

plans.name: Accounting add-on
plans.for: Owners who want the books in one place

faq: Do I need to buy special hardware?
No. It runs in the browser on Android phones and tablets, iPads and Windows PCs. Add a receipt printer and cash drawer if you want printed bills; we will tell you which models work.
What happens if the internet drops?
The point of sale keeps taking orders through short internet drops and syncs when the connection returns. We recommend a 4G backup connection for busy outlets.
Does it handle VAT, SSCL and service charge?
Yes. Taxes are calculated in the order Sri Lankan rules require, with tax invoices for VAT-registered businesses and plain bills for those that are not.
You do. Each business has its own database in its own cloud project, and you can export your data at any time.
Can I try it before paying?
Yes. After a demo we set up a trial with your own menu so your staff can use it before you decide.
We aim to have you live within a week of receiving your menu and prices. We load the menu, set up bills and train your staff.
Restaurants, cafés, bakeries and bars are our focus. Wholesale and retail businesses can also use it; ask us for a demonstration.
